test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct with regard to the principal axis of a spherical mirror?

(a) A principal axis is an imaginary line extended on both sides of the mirror.

(b) A principal axis passes through the center of curvature, principal focus and pole.

(c) The principal axis for a curved mirror is curved.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (a) and (b) are correct**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **(a) A principal axis is an imaginary line extended on both sides of the mirror.**
 
• ✅ This is correct.
 
 
• The principal axis is an imaginary straight line that passes through key points of the mirror, such as the **pole (P)** and **center of curvature (C)**, and can be extended indefinitely on both sides.
